lifestage.quote: complete pet food for medium-size puppy dogs and adult pregnant and lactating bitches

texts.about_this_item: Monge Natural Superpremium Medium Starter for mother and baby dogs, Rich in Chicken (Best for Breeders 15 kg bag): a complete pet food for medium-size puppies and adult pregnant and lactating bitches (10-32 kg). The first ingredient is chicken, and fresh meat makes the formula digestible and palatable. Next-generation XOS (xylo-oligosaccharide) prebiotics support intestinal wellness; glucosamine and chondroitin sulphate support joint development, and a balanced calcium/phosphorus ratio supports regular growth of the puppy's bones and joints. No added dyes or artificial preservatives. Made in Italy.
texts.ingredient_information: Composition: chicken (dried 30%, fresh meat 10%), rice, animal fat (chicken oil purified at 99.5%), dried beet pulp, hydrolysed animal proteins (liver), maize, brewers' yeast inactivated, oats, dried eggs, fish (dried salmon), fish oil (salmon oil), minerals, yeast products (MOS 1%), XOS 0.3%, yucca schidigera 0.3%, spirulina 0.3%, glucosamine 0.057%, chondroitin sulphate 0.04%. Analytical components: crude protein 31%, crude fibre 1.5%, crude fat 22%, crude ash 7%, calcium 1.5%, phosphorus 1.1%, n-3 fatty acids 0.5%, n-6 fatty acids 5.5%. Metabolisable energy 4,500 kcal/kg.
texts.feeding_instructions: Recommended daily feeding intakes (see the table on the pack) may be split into 3 or more daily meals. Individual requirements vary with size, age and activity. Always have clean, fresh water available. Introduce gradually over at least one week when replacing another food.
